description: This file defines a 'Session' class for managing browser sessions, including starting/stopping daemons, connecting via sockets, and deleting session data. It is part of the Playwright core tools, specifically for CLI client session management.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Manages browser session lifecycle, including compatibility checks, running commands, stopping, deleting data, and managing daemon processes.

classes.name: SocketConnectionClient
classes.description: Handles socket communication with the browser session, sending messages, receiving responses, and managing connection lifecycle.

methods.name: renderResolvedConfig
methods.description: Generates a human-readable configuration summary for a session.
